single.rule: Back the side the Ridge attack/defence engine likes by >= 1 pts versus the close.
Back the side the Ridge attack/defence engine likes by >= 2 pts versus the close.
Back the side the Ridge attack/defence engine likes by >= 3 pts versus the close.
Over/under the Ridge attack/defence engine total when it differs from the close by >= 2 pts.
Over/under the Ridge attack/defence engine total when it differs from the close by >= 3 pts.
Back the side the Elo engine likes by >= 1 pts versus the close.
Back the side the Elo engine likes by >= 2 pts versus the close.
Back the side the Elo engine likes by >= 3 pts versus the close.
Over/under the Elo engine total when it differs from the close by >= 2 pts.
Over/under the Elo engine total when it differs from the close by >= 3 pts.
Moneyline where our win probability exceeds the de-vigged market by >= 3%.
Moneyline where our win probability exceeds the de-vigged market by >= 5%.
Underdog moneylines where our probability beats the de-vigged market by >= 3 pts.
Back every home underdog against the spread.
Back the underdog in divisional games against the spread.
Back the team with >= 3 more days of rest against the spread.
Fade a team that is favoured in its first game back from a bye.
Under in divisional games.
Back a team playing its first game after a bye against the spread.
Under when the reported wind is >= 15 mph.
Under when the reported temperature is <= 32 F.
Over in domes and closed roofs.
Under in Thursday games.
Back the side where our own line beats the *opening* line by >= 2 pts (opening lines exist for 2021 only).
Back the home team against the spread in every game (vig benchmark).
Bet the over in every game (vig benchmark).
Back the side that covered, chosen after the game (deliberate lookahead; must be rejected).

parlay.rule: Each week, the two largest model-vs-close ATS disagreements, combined in a 2-leg parlay at closing prices.
parlay.correlation_note: Cross-game legs; independence is a close approximation (see correlation page).

parlay.rule: Each week, the three largest model-vs-close ATS disagreements, combined in a 3-leg parlay.
parlay.correlation_note: Cross-game legs; independence is a close approximation.

parlay.rule: Each week, the two largest model-vs-market underdog moneyline edges, combined in a 2-leg parlay.
Same-game parlay: the model's ATS side and the model's total side of the same game.
parlay.correlation_note: Legs are correlated (see correlation page); priced here at the product of the legs, which is what an independent-pricing book would quote.
